newsitem.title: USA: Trigon Healthcare 1996 pre-tax net rises.
newsitem.headline: Trigon Healthcare 1996 pre-tax net rises.

text.p: Trigon Healthcare Inc Wednesday said 1996 net income was $120.6 million, up from $107 million in 1995.
The 1996 results are before income taxes and extraordinary items and exclude a non-operating gain on the sale of a subsidiary in the fourth quarter, the company said.
The 1995 results exclude the effect of the copayment refund program.

The company said it is still in its quiet period after its Initial Public Offering closed on January 31, and was limited to reporting the data contained a recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Premium and fee revenues increased 12.4 percent to $1.766 billion in 1996 from $1.571 billion in 1995, the firm said.

It said 1996 results reflect a non-operating gain of $62.3 million, or $40 million after tax, on the sale of its Health Communication Services Inc unit to National Data Corp. The sale closed on December 31, 1996.
